description: This file defines a controller class 'Authorize' within the Opencart admin module, responsible for handling authorization-related email notifications and reset actions. It contains methods to send authorization emails and handle reset requests for user authorization tokens.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class for handling authorization email notifications and reset actions within the admin area of Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles sending authorization email to the user if a session code exists, assembling email data and scheduling the email task.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles reset requests for user authorization tokens, sending reset emails if user info is available and the reset type is 'authorize'.
